# Contract: characters (v1.4)

Producer: ENV C (generated humanoids + animations). Consumer: ENV A (NPC/crew prefabs).
Until delivered, ENV A uses capsule placeholders with the same node names.

## Rig
* One shared humanoid skeleton `rig_humanoid` (generated by `tools/blender/characters/rig.py`),
  height 1.78 m (default), Y-up, facing −Z, root at the feet. Bones (exact names):
  `root, hips, spine, chest, neck, head, clavicle.L/R, upper_arm.L/R, forearm.L/R, hand.L/R,
  thigh.L/R, shin.L/R, foot.L/R, toe.L/R` plus finger chains `thumb|index|middle|ring|pinky_0[1-3].L/R`.
* Body variants are produced by scaling bones within ±6% height and through shape keys
  (build, gender, age); all of them share the skeleton so animations retarget 1:1.

## Visual scene shape (`world/characters/<id>/<id>.tscn`)
```
<Root> Node3D
├── Skeleton3D (rig_humanoid) with MeshInstance3D parts (body, head, outfit, gear)
├── AnimationPlayer with library "humanoid" (names below)
├── Marker attachments as BoneAttachment3D: `HandR` (weapon), `HandL`, `Head` (mask/hat), `Back` (bag),
│   `Hip` (pager/radio)
└── Hitbox proxies are NOT here (ENV A builds hitboxes from bone names)
```
Specials add: Wrecker `Faceplate`, `Visor` MeshInstance3D nodes (A hides them on break) and
`HeadArmored` variants; Phantom `Goggles` with emission; Bulwark `Shield` scene (separate, with
`Collision`); Longshot `LaserOrigin`.

## Animation names (library "humanoid"), in-place, 30 fps, loops marked *
`idle*, idle_alert*, walk*, run*, sprint*, crouch_idle*, crouch_walk*, strafe_l*, strafe_r*,
walk_back*, turn_l, turn_r, aim_rifle*, aim_pistol*, fire_rifle, fire_pistol, reload_rifle,
reload_pistol, melee, death_front, death_back, hit_react, surrender, kneel_cuffed*, hands_up*,
cower*, lie_down*, tied*, flee*, phone_call*, radio_call, pager_answer*, investigate_look*,
smoke*, lean_wall*, sit_chair*, desk_type*, browse*, downed*, tased*, kick_charge, kick_hit,
shield_walk*, shield_bang, heal_ally, dozer_walk*, climb_ladder*, carry_bag_walk*, throw_bag,
interact_low*, interact_mid*, interact_high*, drill_place`
First-person viewmodel arms: separate rig `rig_arms` (C) plus animation sets per `WeaponDef.anim_set`
(B requests new sets via the lead).

## v1.1 clarifications (QD-2, D-029)
* Producer: **ENV D** (D-027), no longer ENV C.
* Exact node paths in `world/characters/<id>/<id>.tscn`: `<Root>/Skeleton3D` (node name literally
  `Skeleton3D`), `<Root>/AnimationPlayer`, and BoneAttachment3D nodes `HandR`, `HandL`, `Head`, `Back`, `Hip` as
  children of `Skeleton3D`. Clips are played as `"humanoid/<clip>"`. The library comes from a single shared
  `char_anim_humanoid` glb, converted to an AnimationLibrary resource by ENV D's assembly tool.
* Masks: `game/assets/masks/mask_<name>.glb`. The MaskDef.model scene has its pivot at the face centre and −Z forward, and
  attaches to `Head`.

## v1.2 (QD-3, QB-51, D-038)
* Each BoneAttachment3D (`HandR`, `HandL`, `Head`, `Back`, `Hip`) has a child `Marker3D` named **`Socket`**
  carrying the attach offset, because a BoneAttachment3D's own transform is overwritten by the bone. Attach to
  `<Marker>/Socket`: the weapon at `HandR/Socket` (weapon X right, Y up, −Z muzzle), the mask at `Head/Socket` (face
  centre; MaskDef pivot seats there), loot bags at `Back/Socket`, and the pager/radio at `Hip/Socket`.
* Masks: ENV A attaches masks with ENV B's `MaskCatalog.resolve()/from_descriptor()` + `MaskComposer.instantiate()`
  (by class name). ENV A never builds mask visuals itself.
* Assembled character scenes keep their skinned meshes as binary `.res` beside the scene (~1.2 MB each,
  accepted; repo size watched per D-011).
* `world/characters/characters.json` is the index of assembled characters (id → scene path).

## v1.3: animation facts and first-person viewmodel (QD-5, D-041)

### Third-person animation facts (ENV D → ENV A)
* Clip speeds at 1.78 m (m/s): walk 1.6, run 3.5, sprint 5.75, crouch_walk 1.5, strafe 1.2, walk_back 1.3,
  flee 4.0, carry_bag_walk 2.4. Playback `speed_scale = v / clip_speed` (× `Skeleton3D.motion_scale` for other heights).
* `turn_l`/`turn_r`: ENV A yaws the root ±90° linearly over 0.8 s. `death_front` = face-down, `death_back` =
  onto the back (pick from the hit direction).
* Animation event frames (30 fps) are listed in `game/assets/characters/char_anim_humanoid/SOURCE.txt`
  (reload mag_out/mag_in/done, radio key_on/key_off, throw_bag release, melee hit, drill_place attach,
  death impact). ENV A syncs gameplay to them.
* Third-person weapon: the weapon origin (visual_slots firing-hand pivot) goes at `HandR/Socket` (18° grip rake);
  the support hand IKs to the weapon's `LeftHandIK`.

### First-person viewmodel (`rig_arms` = `char_arms_fp`)
* `root` = camera origin, −Z forward; arm/finger bones use the humanoid contract names. Helper bones: `weapon`
  (child of `hand.R` at the grip offset, weapon axes; ENV A attaches the WeaponVisual via a BoneAttachment3D
  on it) and `magazine` (child of `weapon`, identity when seated, animated during reloads).
* One AnimationLibrary per `WeaponDef.anim_set` (`pistol`, `smg`, `rifle`, `shotgun`, `lmg`, `sniper`), played as
  `"<anim_set>/<clip>"`. Clips: `idle*`, `ads_idle*`, `draw`, `holster`, `fire`, `fire_ads`, `reload`, `reload_empty`,
  `sprint*`, plus `reload_start` / `reload_loop` / `reload_end` (shell-by-shell sets) and `bolt` (sniper).
* Reload event frames (mag_out, mag_swap, mag_in, slide_release, done) are in the clip set's SOURCE.txt.
  ENV A drives the weapon model's `Slide` / `Pump` / `Bolt` nodes from those events.

## v1.4: per-set viewmodel details (D-044)
* **Shotgun:** the pump action is part of `fire`/`fire_ads` (PD2). Shell-by-shell = `reload_start` + n × `reload_loop`
  (looped, one shell, shell_in@8) + `reload_end`, or `reload_end_empty` (adds a pump). `reload`/`reload_empty` are pre-composed
  for 6 rounds. Matching data: reload_start_s 0.4, reload_per_round_s 0.4333, reload_end_s 0.4 (1.2 empty).
* **Sniper:** a separate `bolt` / `bolt_ads` clip (27 frames) plays after each shot (9 + 27 frames = 1.2 s ≈ 50 rpm).
* **Full-auto** fire clips are 3 frames and restart every shot.
* `rig_arms` `weapon` bone: identity under hand.R except during `sniper_bolt*` and `sniper_reload_empty` (the left hand holds the gun).
* Part travel for ENV A: pump 0.075 m; bolt lift 62° + 0.075 m; LMG feed cover 78°. Weapon models with a hinged feed cover
  expose `FeedCover` (pivot at the rear hinge, rotating about local X) (visual_slots.md).

## v1.5: batch-2/3 viewmodel sets (D-053, D-058)
* Sets: `akimbo`, `revolver`, `break_action`, `lever`, `bow`, `crossbow`, `launcher`, `flamethrower`, `saw`, `minigun`,
  `shotgun_box` (box/drum-fed shotguns Harrow/Brute; D-058), plus pistol `fire_auto`/`fire_auto_ads` (3 f).
* Loop naming: Godot strips a `_loop` suffix only when the short name is free, so hold loops are named `fire_hold`
  (flamethrower, minigun) and `cut_hold` (saw); the lever keeps `reload_loop`. Every clip imports exactly as named.
* Shell-fed sets (shotgun, lever) always use the shell pieces (D-053). Lever `fire` includes the lever cycle
  (lever_open/lever_close events).
* Bow: held in hand.L; the `weapon` bone carries the bow (origin = riser grip, Y = arrow, Z = up the riser) at
  hand.L × `fp.offhand_grip`. The arrow rides the `magazine` bone (drawn back 0.40 m × draw, hidden at release).
  SOURCE `curve.bow_<clip>: draw=…` gives per-frame draw (0 brace … 1 full); ENV A bends StringUpper/Lower so the nock
  sits 0.175 + 0.40 × draw m behind the grip. `fire` = release, `reload` = nock; `draw_string`'s last frame = `hold` frame 0.
* The `weapon` bone moves relative to hand.R during the lever cycle and every bow clip (SOURCE `weapon_bone` lists them).
* Weapon-model layout assumed by the choreography: break-action hinge forward of and below the breech face; lever
  loading gate on the right; saw blade + side grip on the left; minigun left side grip and ammo box on the left.
* Bulwark `shield_idle*` (humanoid, 3.6 s, speed 0) blends seamlessly with `shield_walk` frame 0.
